prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original, premium detailed CHARACTER PARTS DESIGN SHEET for DIMENSIONS FRONT, for Blender artists. Reference image is the current project model, used for identity, proportions, basic forms and weapon envelope. Improve every visible surface: designed layered construction, credible bevels, recessed vents, seams, fasteners, articulations, material contrast. Keep the hero recognizable. Light warm-gray drafting background, clean large landscape 3:2 composition, polished colored 3D concept illustration. Layout: left third full body FRONT and BACK aligned neutral A pose, weapons displayed separately. Right two-thirds five clearly separated generously sized panels: HEAD front/profile/back; TORSO shell front/back with exploded outer layer; ARM shoulder/upper arm/elbow/forearm/hand separated; LEG thigh/knee/shin/foot separated; WEAPON side/top and exploded main components. Show real thick buildable forms, precise assembly leaders; no invented numeric measurements, unreadable paragraphs, logos or legal claims. Only short headings HEAD, TORSO, ARMS, LEGS, WEAPON and exact hero name. Keep exposed joints free to bend, no plates bridging joints. Detail must read at mobile-game scale. This is an artistic concept, not a certified dimensioned engineering drawing. Slim feminine full robotic body with existing rounded chest armor pods, narrow waist, circular joints and athletic plated legs. Brushed titanium, graphite and emerald-mint light. Enclosed layered mechanical mask with recessed narrow angular twin green optics, tapered nasal plate, three chin vent slits, split cheek plates and flush glowing temple rings; dark articulated neck with titanium vertebra rings. Original 'Optic Ridge' armor: paired scalloped titanium chest cradles, fine green V-shaped torso circuitry, thin twin forearm rails, split beveled thigh tabs and shallow chevron knee/boot inlays, many small countersunk fasteners. No exposed skin. Long graphite/titanium sniper rifle with a green optic and perforated handguard, original weapon envelope. Preserve body, chest pod and head shapes from the reference. Name 'SIVRA QUELL'. Upgrade: use a consistent hierarchy of broad clean shells, secondary inset panels and restrained small hardware; add rear service panels, protected cable routing, articulated limb guards and individually shaped material edges. Preserve weapon class and hero colors. For Ione the focus emitter axis must point HORIZONTALLY FORWARD, never upward. For Timmy improve transparent visor clarity so tabby face is clearly visible; no guns. For Traveler keep orb and no staff.
